description: A new leak suggests Redmi is developing the Turbo 6 and Turbo 6 Max smartphones with 7-inch displays and 10,000mAh batteries. According to a tipster, the standard model could use the unannounced MediaTek Dimensity 8600 chipset, while the Turbo 6 Max may feature the rumoured Dimensity 9600s processor. The higher-end variant is also tipped to offer a 2K display, ultrasonic fingerprint sensor, metal frame and IP68 and IP69 ratings. The Turbo 6 Max could debut in January 2027.
title: Redmi Turbo 6 Series Chipset Details Leaked, Could Be Equipped With 10,000mAh Battery

description: Samsung could delay the launch of the Galaxy Z TriFold 2, according to a new report from a tipster on Naver. The leak suggests rising costs may push the handset beyond its original launch schedule, despite a redesigned hinge that could make it thinner and lighter. The report also claims Samsung's rumoured slidable smartphone may debut before the TriFold 2. Earlier reports suggest the slidable device could feature a rollable OLED display and arrive around the Galaxy S28 series or in early 2028.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z TriFold 2 Could Be Delayed as Company Plans Slidable Phone's Debut, Tipster Claims

description: Bonzo Lend has suffered a $9 million exploit after an attacker manipulated the price of the SAUCE token through a flaw in the Supra oracle verification system. The exploit enabled the attacker to borrow assets far exceeding the value of the deposited collateral. While Supra has patched the vulnerability, both Bonzo Lend and Hedera said their core smart contracts and blockchain infrastructure were not compromised
title: Bonzo Lend Hit by $9 Million Oracle Exploit on Hedera Network

description: Tecno has confirmed that the Camon 50 Ultra 5G will launch in India on July 17 at 12pm IST. Ahead of its debut, official teasers and an Amazon microsite have revealed its design, colour options, AI features and availability details. The smartphone is expected to feature a 144Hz AMOLED display, MediaTek Dimensity 7400 Ultimate chipset, triple rear cameras, a 6,500mAh battery with 45W fast charging, IP66, IP68, IP69 and IP69K ratings, and three months of Google AI Plus membership.
title: Tecno Camon 50 Ultra 5G India Launch Roundup: Launch Date, Expected Specifications, Features

description: Google Pixel 11 Pro Fold has appeared in a fresh Telegram leak, revealing the foldable in a Pine colour with a light gold frame ahead of its expected August 12 launch. The render also points to refinements to the rear camera module, including a revised layout and a larger LED flash. Previous reports suggest the handset will feature Google's Tensor G6 chipset, a 4,800mAh battery, a thinner chassis and a new primary rear camera. Google is expected to unveil the device next month.
title: Google Pixel 11 Pro Fold Spotted in Pine Colourway Ahead of Made by Google Event

description: Bitcoin traded near $63,000 on Monday despite rising tensions in the Middle East. Analysts said renewed institutional buying has supported the market, while investors await US inflation data and Federal Reserve commentary for clues on the next move in crypto markets.
title: Bitcoin Holds Near $63,000 Despite Renewed Geopolitical Tensions

description: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced has sold 2 million copies, Ubisoft has confirmed. The game reached the sales milestone on its launch day. Black Flag Resynced is a full remake of Assassin's Creed IV: Black Flag, which released on PC, PS3, and Xbox 360 in 2013.
title: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced Sells 2 Million Copies on Launch Day

description: Sony has launched the LinkBuds Clip open-ear true wireless earbuds in India after debuting them in North America earlier this year. Priced at Rs. 18,990, the earbuds feature an open-ear clip design, 10mm drivers, AI-assisted call processing and Bluetooth 5.3 with multipoint connectivity. They also support three listening modes, Google Fast Pair, Swift Pair and Google Gemini. Sony claims up to 37 hours of total battery life with the charging case and an IPX4 rating for sweat and splash resistance.
title: Sony LinkBuds Clip Launched in India With Open-Ear Clip Design, Up to 37 Hours of Battery Life: Price, Features

description: The Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI), in a recent press release, clarified the regulatory position of the 140 and 1600 series phone numbers mandate. TRAI said that it has mandated the use of 1600 series phone numbers for BFSI firms and for government-to-citizen communication. Hence, the 1600 series phone numbers cannot be blocked by platforms in India. Similarly, these phone numbers can neither be tagged as spam nor filtered out by the call management systems, under the Telecom Commercial Communications Customer Preference Regulation (TCCCPR).
title: TRAI Confirms 1600 and 140 Series Phone Numbers Cannot Be Tagged, Filtered

description: Gadgets360 has launched Shield, a device protection plan covering phones, laptops, tablets, smartwatches, and appliances. Coverage options include accidental damage, extended warranty, cyber protection, and loss or theft, depending on the device and plan selected. The protection plan has a network of 400+ authorised service centres across 20+ states. Gadgets360 Shield already has over 4 million customers and has settled more than 150,000 claims, with a 4.6-star satisfaction score. The protection plan is now available on Amazon.
title: Gadgets360 Shield Device Protection Plan Launched With Accidental Damage, Theft Cover and Extended Warranty

description: Samsung has increased the Galaxy M47 5G price in India just days after the smartphone went on sale. The base 6GB + 128GB variant now costs Rs. 32,999, while the 8GB + 128GB and 8GB + 256GB models are priced at Rs. 36,999 and Rs. 41,999, respectively. The revised prices are up to Rs. 8,000 higher than the launch prices. Although smartphone prices have risen across brands because of higher memory costs, the timing of this increase is unusual.
title: Samsung Galaxy M47 5G Gets Substantial Price Hike in India Days After It Was Launched

description: OnePlus Pad Go 2 and Pad Lite prices in India have been raised in India across variants. The company has updated its online store in the country to reflect the new prices. Compared to their launch prices, these price hikes are even more significant. For reference, the OnePlus Pad Go 2 was launched in India in December 2025 at a starting price of Rs. 26,999. On the other hand, the OnePlus Pad Lite was unveiled in the country in July last year with a price tag of Rs. 15,999. This means that both OnePlus Pad Go 2 and Pad Go Lite now retail at a Rs. 3,000 premium.
title: OnePlus Pad Go 2, Pad Lite Price in India Increased Amid Ongoing RAM Shortage

description: Moto G77 Power is now on sale in India with an instant discount of up to Rs. 2,500 with IDFC First Bank, Kotak Bank, ICICI Bank, and SBI credit cards. Jio customers can also avail 500GB of cloud storage for 18 months and free access to Google’s Gemini Pro plan with the purchase of the Moto G77 Power. The new handset is now on sale in India via Flipkart and the Motorola India online store. The Moto G77 Power is offered in three colourways, namely Pantone Fuchsia Red, Pantone Impenetrable, and Pantone Nautical Blue.
title: Moto G77 Power With 7,000mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Camera Goes on Sale in India: Price, Offers

description: Redmi Note 17 will be launched in India in at least two colour options, namely Blue and Dark Night, according to a tipster. The handset will reportedly be available for purchase in the country in a 6GB + 128GB RAM and storage configuration. In China, the Redmi Note 17 will reportedly be powered by Qualcomm’s octa core Snapdragon 4 Gen 4 chipset, while the Pro model might arrive with a Snapdragon 6s Gen 4 SoC. We already know that the Redmi Note 17 series will be launched in China on July 14 at 7 pm local time (4:30 pm IST). The display of the Redmi Note 17 Pro is confirmed to offer Corning Gorilla Glass Victus 2 protection.
title: Redmi Note 17 Colours, Storage Options in India Leaked as Tipster Reveals Key Specifications of Chinese Variant

description: God of War Laufey, the next mainline God of War game, will be available on disc, developer Santa Monica Studio has confirmed. The studio's confirmation means God of War Laufey will be released on PS5 before January 2028, Sony's Sony's cutoff for ending physical disc production for new PlayStation games.
title: God of War Laufey Will Get a Disc Version Before Sony Ends Disc Production in 2028

description: Lava Virat V1 series will be launched in India on July 21 at 12 pm IST, the Indian smartphone maker has announced. The Lava Virat V1 5G and Lava Virat V1 4G will be launched in the country as the first two handsets in the lineup. A dedicated microsite for the Lava Virat V1 series is now live on Flipkart, confirming that the lineup will be available for purchase in India via the e-commerce platform. Apart from this, the company has also revealed the design of the two upcoming smartphones. The Lava Virat V1 4G is shown to feature a square-shaped rear camera module, housing two camera lenses. The handset is confirmed to boast a 13-megapixel primary rear camera unit, along with an LED flash. The upcoming smartphone is similar to the Lava Smart 4 Plus.
title: Lava Virat V1 5G and Virat V1 4G India Launch Date Revealed Along With Design, Colourways: Expected Specifications

description: Apple is reportedly developing new versions of the Apple Pencil with USB-C and Apple Pencil Pro for launch alongside next-generation iPad Pro models in early 2027. According to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman, the refresh is expected to help Apple comply with upcoming European Union battery regulations that require easier battery replacement. The report does not confirm user-replaceable batteries or reveal any new features. Current Apple Pencil models are difficult to repair because of their sealed design and extensive use of adhesive.
title: Redesigned Apple Pencil Models in Development, Could Debut Alongside M6 iPad Pro in 2027: Report

description: Apple will reportedly launch an M7 Ultra-based server processor with support for up to 1.5TB of RAM, Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman writes in the latest edition of his weekly newsletter ‘Power On’. Apple is currently developing two new chipsets for AI servers based on the unreleased M5 Ultra and M7 Ultra processors. These two chipsets will reportedly be foundational to Apple’s future AI server strategy. The M5 Ultra-based chipset, bearing the codename J246, will reportedly be deployed soon.
title: Apple’s M7 Ultra-Based Server Chip to Reportedly Offer Up to 1.5TB Memory, Enhanced Neural Processing
